reviews.title: Good product at a good Price
reviews.comment: I used this drive to replace one in my computer that quit working properly. It fits perfectly. The drive works as it should and is a study construction. Its read/write speeds are comparable with my previous drive and sounds normal while working. A good buy for a replacement or add-on to a system.
reviews.author: Chris West

reviews.title: Replacement Drive
